process LEAFCUTTER_CLUSTERREGTOOLS {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/leafcutter:2.0.3--pyhd8ed1ab_0':
        'quay.io/biocontainers/leafcutter:2.0.3--pyhd8ed1ab_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(juncfiles)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*_pooled")                      , emit: pooled
    tuple val(meta), path("*_refined")                     , emit: refined
    tuple val(meta), path("*_sortedlibs")                  , emit: sortedlibs
    tuple val(meta), path("*_perind*.counts.gz")           , emit: counts
    tuple val(meta), path("*_perind_numers*.counts.gz")    , emit: numers
    // WARN: Version information not provided by tool on CLI. Please update version string below when bumping container versions.
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('leafcutter'), val("2.0.3"), topic: versions, emit: versions_leafcutter

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    printf '%s\\n' ${juncfiles} | sort > juncfiles_list.txt

    leafcutter-cluster \\
        -j juncfiles_list.txt \\
        -r ./ \\
        -o $prefix \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def const_suffix = task.ext.args?.contains("--includeconst") || task.ext.args?.contains("-C") ? ".const" : ""
    """
    touch ${prefix}_pooled
    touch ${prefix}_refined
    touch ${prefix}_sortedlibs
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}_perind${const_suffix}.counts.gz
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}_perind_numers${const_suffix}.counts.gz
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/leafcutter/clusterregtools"
description: "Cluster RNA-seq junction reads extracted by regtools and refine them\
  \ based on read counts and ratios for alternative splicing analysis"
keywords:
- "splicing"
- "RNA-seq"
- "clustering"
- "junctions"
tools:
- leafcutter:
    description: "Annotation-free quantification of RNA splicing"
    homepage: "https://leafcutter2.github.io/leafcutter-ds/"
    documentation: "https://leafcutter2.github.io/leafcutter-ds/tutorials/clustering/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/leafcutter2/leafcutter-ds"
    doi: "10.1038/s41588-017-0004-9"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:leafcutter"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'experiment1',\
        \ single_end:false ]`\n"
  - juncfiles:
      type: "file"
      description: "Text file listing paths to junction files (one per line), where\
        \ junction files contain chromosome, start, end, strand, and read count information\
        \ extracted by regtools"
      pattern: "*.{txt,junc}"
      ontologies: []
output:
  pooled:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'experiment1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*_pooled':
        type: "file"
        description: "Initial pooled junction file containing aggregated junction\
          \ information across all samples"
        pattern: "*_pooled"
        ontologies: []
  refined:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'experiment1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*_refined':
        type: "file"
        description: "Refined cluster definitions after filtering based on minimum\
          \ reads and junction ratios"
        pattern: "*_refined"
        ontologies: []
  sortedlibs:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'experiment1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*_sortedlibs':
        type: "file"
        description: "List of sorted junction files processed during clustering"
        pattern: "*_sortedlibs"
        ontologies: []
  counts:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'experiment1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*_perind*.counts.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Compressed per-individual junction counts matrix (includes constitutive\
          \ introns if -C flag used)"
        pattern: "*_perind{.const,}counts.gz"
        ontologies: []
  numers:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'experiment1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*_perind_numers*.counts.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "Compressed numerator counts for junction usage ratios (includes\
          \ constitutive introns if -C flag used)"
        pattern: "*_perind_numers{.const,}counts.gz"
        ontologies: []
  versions_leafcutter:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - leafcutter:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - "2.0.3":
        type: "string"
        description: "The version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - leafcutter:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - "2.0.3":
        type: "string"
        description: "The version of the tool"
authors:
- "@JTL-lab"
maintainers:
- "@JTL-lab"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
